adjudication.rationale: Looking at refreshOAuthTokens.ts (lines 1-22), when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, the function makes a POST request to the endpoint with only calcomUserId and appSlug in the body, but no authentication header or secret is included. The comment says 'The response should only contain the access token and expiry date', meaning this endpoint would need to return OAuth tokens based solely on user ID and app slug without any authentication, which is a security vulnerability. The webhook endpoint (app-credential.ts) does verify CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET, but the outgoing sync request in refreshOAuthTokens.ts does not include any authentication.
